goal: Avoid an assertion failure when evaluating a package whose orphan child is already in the mempool
Ensure orphan transactions admitted through non-peer paths like RPC are cleaned up during relay
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support with verified bug reproduction and no open objections
Verified by reproducing the assertion failure on master and testing the fix (fametrano)
Withdrew an earlier suggestion for proactive mempool hook cleanup in favor of this fix (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it addresses an edge case assertion failure rather than a network vulnerability
It only affects nodes when an orphan child enters the mempool via RPC before its parent arrives from a peer
The fix keeps package processing reliable without risking incorrect transaction relay
